_comment: Event types for the market_events calendar (2026-09-21). scripts/fetch_events.py upserts these into event_types and keeps market_events in sync for every type whose source is fred/rule/curated. Add a type by adding an entry here; source 'manual' types (Round 2 admin page) are never touched by the script.
